requirement: Determine whether Pro Finance Home Sh.A. (licensed NBFI) can convert into a bank by legal transformation or must establish a new bank and transfer assets/liabilities
requirement_sq: Të përcaktohet nëse Pro Finance Home Sh.A. (IFJB e licencuar) mund të shndërrohet në bankë përmes transformimit ligjor apo duhet të themelojë bankë të re dhe të transferojë asetet/detyrimet
notes: No conversion procedure found in search-accessible material. Treat as top question for CBK pre-application meeting.

requirement: Pre-application meeting(s) with CBK Licensing Department before filing
requirement_sq: Takim(e) para aplikimit me Departamentin e Licencimit të BQK-së para dorëzimit

requirement: Complete licence application with all annexes and proof of licensing-fee payment (incomplete applications not reviewed)
requirement_sq: Aplikim i plotë për licencë me të gjitha shtojcat dhe dëshminë e pagesës së tarifës së licencimit (aplikimet e paplota nuk shqyrtohen)
notes: Fee non-refundable.

requirement: CBK preliminary approval or refusal within 3 months of complete application
requirement_sq: BQK miraton ose refuzon paraprakisht brenda 3 muajve nga aplikimi i plotë
notes: Timeline under 08/L-304 may differ.

requirement: Fulfil preliminary-approval conditions then file final-licence application; CBK pre-opening on-site examination
requirement_sq: Përmbushja e kushteve të miratimit paraprak, pastaj aplikimi për licencë përfundimtare; ekzaminimi në vend i BQK-së para hapjes
evidence_needed: Readiness evidence: systems; policies; staff; premises
notes: Pre-approval is revoked if the bank does not meet the licence conditions within one (1) year (2020 regulation, search extract).

requirement: Minimum initial capital deposited at CBK before final licence: ≥ EUR 7m (2020 regulation citing 04/L-093 Art. 15)
requirement_sq: Kapitali fillestar minimal i depozituar në BQK para licencës përfundimtare: ≥ 7 mln € (rregullorja 2020 me referencë në 04/L-093 neni 15)
notes: 08/L-304 reportedly INCREASES minimum capital – new amount NOT obtained. Model default threshold EUR 7m flagged HISTORICAL; user must override when verified.

requirement: Paid-in capital must remain ≥ legal minimum at all times
requirement_sq: Kapitali i paguar duhet të mbetet në çdo kohë ≥ minimumit ligjor

requirement: Total capital adequacy ratio ≥ 12% of RWA
requirement_sq: Raporti i mjaftueshmërisë së kapitalit total ≥ 12% e APR
notes: Corroborated by CBK speech (2022) and CBK Financial Stability Map (2025). Under 08/L-304 (CRR-aligned) structure may change (CET1 4.5% / T1 6% / Total 8% + buffers + P2R) – VERIFY.

requirement: Tier 1 / CET1 minimum ratio
requirement_sq: Raporti minimal i Nivelit 1 / CET1
notes: Threshold NOT obtained – model shows Tier 1 ratio but no verdict until user enters verified threshold.

requirement: Capital conservation / other buffers and Pillar 2 add-on (SREP)
requirement_sq: Tamponi ruajtës i kapitalit / tamponë të tjerë dhe shtesa e Shtyllës 2 (SREP)
notes: CBK may impose bank-specific add-ons for a de-novo bank – management buffer modelled as editable 'target CAR'.

requirement: Leverage ratio requirement
requirement_sq: Kërkesa për raportin e levës

requirement: ICAAP and capital plan in business plan
requirement_sq: ICAAP dhe plani i kapitalit në planin e biznesit

requirement: Liquid assets ≥ 25% of short-term liabilities
requirement_sq: Asetet likuide ≥ 25% e detyrimeve afatshkurtra
notes: LCR/NSFR applicability under 08/L-304 not verified.

requirement: Minimum reserve requirement 10% of liabilities < 1 year; up to 50% as vault cash
requirement_sq: Kërkesa për rezervë minimale 10% e detyrimeve me maturim < 1 vit; deri në 50% si para në arkë
notes: Check amendments since 2012.

requirement: Exposure to single client / connected group ≤ 15% of Tier 1 capital
requirement_sq: Ekspozimi ndaj një klienti / grupi të lidhur ≤ 15% e kapitalit të Nivelit 1

requirement: Exposures > 10% of Tier 1 require prior board approval
requirement_sq: Ekspozimet > 10% e Nivelit 1 kërkojnë miratim paraprak të bordit

requirement: Related-party exposure limits and approval
requirement_sq: Kufijtë dhe miratimi i ekspozimeve ndaj palëve të lidhura
notes: Critical given shareholder-linked businesses (e.g. car-dealer partnerships).

requirement: Net open FX position ≤ 15% of Tier 1
requirement_sq: Pozicioni i hapur neto valutor ≤ 15% e Nivelit 1
notes: EUR-only bank → low relevance; USD card-scheme fees are expenses not positions.

requirement: Prior CBK approval for qualifying/key shareholders; fit & proper; source of funds
requirement_sq: Miratimi paraprak i BQK-së për aksionarët me pjesëmarrje cilësore/kyçe; përshtatshmëria dhe ndershmëria; burimi i fondeve
threshold_value: Qualifying holding threshold TBD (10% under CRD – verify)
evidence_needed: UBO chart, source-of-funds evidence, financial statements of shareholders, criminal records

requirement: Board of Directors: odd number of at least 5 members, majority independent non-executive directors, at least one resident of Kosovo; CEO sits ex officio without vote and is not counted
requirement_sq: Bordi i drejtorëve në përputhje me rregullat e përbërjes/pavarësisë të Rregullores për qeverisjen korporative
notes: Search extract of Rregullore për qeverisjen korporative të bankave (BQK). Independent director and related persons ≤1% of voting shares. NBFI boards: ≥3, majority independent. Re-check under 08/L-304.

requirement: Audit committee and risk committee of the board (not required for foreign branches)
requirement_sq: Komiteti i auditimit dhe komiteti i rrezikut i bordit (nuk kërkohen për degët e huaja)

requirement: CBK prior approval of senior managers (CEO and key function holders) – fit & proper
requirement_sq: Miratimi paraprak i BQK-së për menaxherët e lartë (CEO dhe mbajtësit e funksioneve kyçe) – përshtatshmëria dhe ndershmëria
notes: Exact list of approved positions under 08/L-304 to verify.

requirement: Independent internal audit function reporting to audit committee
requirement_sq: Funksion i pavarur i auditimit të brendshëm që raporton te komiteti i auditimit

requirement: Independent risk management and compliance functions
requirement_sq: Funksione të pavarura të menaxhimit të rrezikut dhe të pajtueshmërisë

requirement: AML/CFT programme; designated AML officer; KYC/CDD; sanctions screening; STR reporting to FIU-K
requirement_sq: Programi PPP/LFT; zyrtar i caktuar për PPP; KYC/CDD; kontrolli i sanksioneve; raportimi i transaksioneve të dyshimta te NjIF-K
evidence_needed: AML policy, risk assessment, monitoring system
notes: Pro Finance already subject to AML as NBFI – programme must be upgraded to bank scale.

requirement: Membership in DIFK and payment of risk-based premiums on insured deposits
requirement_sq: Anëtarësimi në FSDK dhe pagesa e primeve të bazuara në rrezik mbi depozitat e siguruara
notes: Law 03/L-216 (as amended): annual premium between 0.3% and 1.5% of the average of opening and closing insured deposit balances, set by DIFK rules; paid in instalments. Rate currently applied not obtained.

requirement: Regulatory reporting to CBK per Regulation on Bank Reporting
requirement_sq: Raportimi rregullativ te BQK sipas Rregullores për raportimin e bankave
evidence_needed: Reporting system (CBS module claimed by vendor)

requirement: Islamic bank / Islamic window defined in law; specific CBK Islamic regulation not found
requirement_sq: Banka islame / dritarja islame e përkufizuar në ligj; nuk u gjet rregullore specifike e BQK-së për bankingun islam
evidence_needed: CBK written confirmation of product permissibility, accounting and Sharia governance expectations
notes: Status of Islamic provisions in 08/L-304 NOT verified.

requirement: Participation in CBK interbank payment system (KIPS) and credit registry
requirement_sq: Pjesëmarrja në sistemin ndërbankar të pagesave të BQK-së (KIPS) dhe në regjistrin e kredive
notes: Fees excluded from Facilization offer.

requirement: Premises meeting security standards; cash vault; BCP/DR
requirement_sq: Ambiente që plotësojnë standardet e sigurisë; trezori; vazhdimësia e biznesit/rimëkëmbja nga fatkeqësitë

requirement: Outsourcing of material functions (incl. CBS hosting/managed services) subject to CBK rules/notification
requirement_sq: Transferimi te palë të treta i funksioneve materiale (përfshirë hostimin/shërbimet e menaxhuara të CBS) i nënshtrohet rregullave/njoftimit të BQK-së
evidence_needed: Outsourcing policy, vendor due diligence, exit plan, data location
notes: Critical: Facilization offers fully hosted/managed platform (data residency and CBK access rights to verify).

requirement: Fulfil all preliminary-approval conditions within 1 year, otherwise the preliminary approval is revoked
requirement_sq: Përmbushja e të gjitha kushteve të miratimit paraprak brenda 1 viti, përndryshe miratimi paraprak revokohet
evidence_needed: Project plan; CBS go-live; capital deposit; key staff approvals
notes: Drives the critical path: core banking implementation, recruitment and the capital deposit must all fit inside 12 months after preliminary approval.

requirement: Income from non-financial services limited to 10% of total net interest income of the previous financial year
requirement_sq: Të ardhurat nga shërbimet jofinanciare kufizohen në 10% të të ardhurave totale neto nga interesi të vitit financiar paraprak
calculation_method: Non-financial income ÷ prior-year net interest income
evidence_needed: Legal opinion on whether Murabaha goods sales and Ijarah rentals count as financial services
notes: Critical for Islamic structures: if Murabaha sale margins or Ijarah rentals are treated as non-financial income the cap could bind. Confirm with CBK.
